description: This file is a Java class named ProductDBUtil that provides database utility methods for managing Product entities, including CRUD operations, retrieving all products, fetching by ID, and creating sales records associated with products.

classes.name: ProductDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to the Product entity in the grocery ordering system.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products from the database and returns them as a list of Product objects.

methods.name: insertProduct
methods.description: Inserts a new product into the database and associates it with an employee.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing product identified by its PrID.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes the product with the specified PrID from the database.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Fetches a product from the database by its PrID.

methods.name: createProductSale
methods.description: Creates sale records for a list of cart products associated with a sale ID, and updates product quantities accordingly.
